name: Water production cost
basis: Illustrative marginal treatment and delivery cost, not a verified Egyptian tariff. Verify against the utility's water production cost ledger and supply contract.

name: Electricity tariff
basis: Illustrative purchased-energy rate; Egyptian tariffs cannot be verified offline. Verify against the current electricity supply contract and invoices.

name: Cooling energy cost
basis: Illustrative marginal cooling delivery cost. Verify against the district cooling operating cost ledger, avoiding retail revenue and energy-cost overlap.

name: Crew call-out cost
basis: Budget allowance for transport and emergency labour per dispatch. Verify against crew timesheets and the maintenance contractor rate card.

name: Pipe repair parts
basis: Budget for one district-main joint/section repair. Verify against the pipe bill of quantities and recent supplier quotations.

name: Pump repair parts
basis: Budget for a pump mechanical/electrical repair. Verify against the pump asset bill of materials and maintenance work orders.

name: Substation restore and inspection
basis: Budget for reset, inspection and minor switchgear work, not transformer replacement. Verify against substation restoration work orders.

name: Chiller repair parts
basis: Budget for a minor chiller component repair. Verify against OEM service quotations and plant work orders.

name: Sensor recalibration or replacement
basis: Budget for a field sensor replacement or calibration. Verify against the instrument register and calibration contractor rate card.

name: Crew response time when sent now
basis: One hour is a district dispatch-to-isolation planning allowance. Verify against dispatch logs and the emergency response SLA.

name: Ongoing loss cut after pipe isolation
basis: Planning allowance: isolation cuts lost-water cost only by 85% after crew arrival until the existing deferred horizon; disruption and secondary purchases continue unchanged. Repair uses planned_factor without damage escalation, plus one extra isolation call-out. Verify against valve isolation plans, post-isolation flows and planned work orders.

name: Maximum deferred repair multiplier
basis: Linear escalation m(w) = min(cap, 1 + (late_multiplier_kind - 1) * w / delay_hours_kind) is a planning choice, with a default cap of three times repair cost. Waiting includes losses to w with no additional response hours. This is not a fitted damage-growth law; verify against matched early and deferred repair work orders.

name: Cost of a crew sent on a false alarm
basis: One unnecessary visit uses the same budget as an emergency crew dispatch. Verify against false-alarm work orders and contractor invoices.

name: Interval between false dispatches
basis: One false dispatch per four unresolved sensor-fault hours is an illustrative frequency, not observed evidence. Verify against alarm and dispatch history.

name: Off-hours cooling cut by a setback
basis: A 35% off-hours reduction is a commissioning target. Verify with occupancy schedules, BMS trends and a setback measurement-and-verification trial.

name: Setback commissioning in the building systems
basis: Budget for BMS scheduling and commissioning. Verify against the controls contractor scope and quotation.

name: Night pressure target after pressure management
basis: Trial target chosen below normal night pressure while retaining service head. Verify against the hydraulic model and minimum customer pressure SLA.

name: Leakage-pressure exponent N1 (FAVAD)
basis: The FAVAD power-law approximation uses a midpoint exponent of one. Calibrate the 0.5–1.5 benchmark range with district pressure-step tests and the leakage study.

name: Pressure-reducing valves and controllers
basis: Budget for pressure-control hardware and installation. Verify against the valve schedule and supplier installation quotations.

name: Supply water temperature raise on mild days
basis: One degree is a trial control reset. Verify against OEM operating limits and building comfort commissioning records.

name: Chiller energy saved per °C of raise
basis: A 2–3% energy reduction per degree is an illustrative engineering benchmark, not a physical law. Verify against OEM performance curves and a metered reset trial.

name: Controls change for temperature reset
basis: Budget for controls programming and commissioning. Verify against the BMS change quotation.

name: Condenser cleaning, per plant
basis: Budget for one plant cleaning intervention. Verify against the condenser service scope and contractor quotation.

name: Planned repair cost relative to an emergency repair
basis: Planned work is budgeted at 60% of emergency crew-plus-parts cost. Verify against matched planned and emergency maintenance work orders.

name: Effective annual discount rate
basis: Planning rate for investment appraisal; verify with finance against the approved capital-budget discount-rate memorandum.

name: Background leakage relative to billed demand
basis: Synthetic baseline leakage is 11.5% of billed demand; this is not a measured district water balance. Verify against minimum-night-flow tests and production/billing meter reconciliation.

name: Maintenance pipe-failure leak proxy
basis: A 100 m3/h leak represents an illustrative future pipe failure. Verify against pipe diameter, hydraulic breach modelling and historical burst work orders.

name: Maintenance trip unserved-load proxy
basis: Assume 45% of current zone electrical demand remains unserved after backup transfer. Verify against the substation contingency and protection study.

name: Maintenance cooling-deficit proxy
basis: Assume half of plant thermal delivery is lost in a future failure. Verify against the plant redundancy and chiller availability study.

name: Maintenance fallback plant thermal delivery
basis: Use 10 MW thermal only when the live plant metric is unavailable. Verify against plant duty records and the rated-load schedule.

name: Utility outage administration, government
basis: Illustrative government account-hour budget for notification and utility customer support only; excludes customer economic harm covered by VoLL. Verify against the utility support cost ledger and outage notification work orders.

name: Value of lost load, government
basis: Illustrative government customer economic outage value, including lost downstream services; not an official Egyptian VoLL. Verify against a local customer interruption-cost survey and the regulator's approved VoLL study, if available.

name: Deferred response horizon, pipe_burst
basis: Continuing erosion can enlarge excavation and pipe damage; this horizon is a planning scenario. Verify against fault-specific restoration logs and the response SLA.

name: Late repair multiplier, pipe_burst
basis: Continuing erosion can enlarge excavation and pipe damage; the multiplier is a planning allowance, not an estimated growth law. Verify against matched early and deferred repair work orders.

name: Plausible saving min, pipe_burst
basis: Planning review threshold for a single district incident, not a cap on the computed value. Verify against the asset replacement budget and historical incident-loss register.

name: Plausible saving max, pipe_burst
basis: Planning review threshold for a single district incident, not a cap on the computed value. Verify against the asset replacement budget and historical incident-loss register.
